ja: 「アゲートシティ――清らかさの伝統」
何が起きてるのか、わからない……

key: Just as soon as I woke up, Team Meteor was in there shouting orders...
en: Just as soon as I woke up, Team Meteor was in there shouting orders...
ja: 目が覚めたと思ったら、チームメテオが中で命令を怒鳴ってて……

key: I was able to get out, but many others are still inside!
en: I was able to get out, but many others are still inside!
ja: 何とか逃げ出せたけど、まだ中には大勢残ってる!

key: Let me at them! I'll beat Team Meteor up!
en: Let me at them! I'll beat Team Meteor up!
ja: やらせろ! チームメテオをぶちのめしてやる!

key: Team Meteor has taken control of Agate City.
en: Team Meteor has taken control of Agate City.
ja: チームメテオが、アゲートシティを制圧した。

key: Several of the Gym Leaders have entered in an attempt to defend it, but they are severely outnumbered.
en: Several of the Gym Leaders have entered in an attempt to defend it, but they are severely outnumbered.
ja: 何人かのジムリーダーが防衛のために乗り込んだが、数で圧倒的に不利な状況だ。

key: Please exercise caution if you're going into the city.
en: Please exercise caution if you're going into the city.
ja: 街に入る場合は、十分に気をつけてください。

key: Please be okay, please be okay, please be okay...
en: Please be okay, please be okay, please be okay...
ja: 無事でいて、無事でいて、無事でいて……
